CommunityApplications.Profile: CamStack — self-hosted camera management. A hub plus optional worker agents: ONVIF/RTSP/Reolink/Hikvision device providers, WebRTC and RTSP restreaming, recording, and a motion + ML detection pipeline that can run on an Intel iGPU, an Intel NPU or a Coral Edge TPU. Install the hub once, then add an agent on any other machine whose hardware you want to put to work.
